items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bennie Moten got that [expletive deleted] from King Oliver’s band... There’s Bennie Moten come to New York.

ctx.x: You got that from that, that rhythm section. Bennie Moten got that [expletive deleted] from King Oliver’s band. If you hear some of the King Oliver records, Canal Street Blues with Armstrong and Oliver, and you listen to Count Basie’s band, you’ll hear the same thing there which was done ten years earlier or maybe 15 years earlier.
So they got the influence from New Orleans.
